# Selected Frequencies

> Full-service podcast editing and production studio — editing, show notes,
> and distribution, handled end to end. UK-based, working worldwide, with
> deep experience in Bitcoin and finance shows.

Founded in 2019 by James Pearce, a producer with eight years in professional
audio (BBC Radio 1, Universal Music, Noisehouse, Point Blank). Selected
Frequencies produces podcasts start to finish so hosts only have to turn up
and have the conversation.

## Services

- Podcast editing from £110 per episode — full edit for pacing, sound and story
- Audio and video production from £165 per episode
- Full production from £335 per episode — editing, show notes, clips and distribution
- Social clips £40 each; multi-camera editing +£95
- Show notes, chapter timestamps and transcript review
- Distribution across podcast platforms and YouTube

Bitcoin accepted as payment.
